description: Requested X/Y exchange for live display. Determinant=-1: not a physical 3-D rotation. Raw mx_uT/my_uT/mz_uT remain sensor-frame values and the ellipsoid calibration is fitted to those raw channels. For a physical +90 degree Z rotation, use rows [[0,-1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]] (det=+1), after verifying board axes.
